__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie. It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A horrifying mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mud monster mudmonster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You have never in your entire life seen such a mean looking small creature,
though it looks rather peaceful, hanging there. The thought of arousing this
cruel creature doesn't seem appealing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bat

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The huge hungry-looking sewer rat sits here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rat

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The small hairy spider.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The giant mean-looking earth beetle crawls towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle beetle

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The giant maggot crawls toward you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle maggot

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The snake slithers towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The evil wanderer is very thin.  He is dressed in a grey cloak.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The evil wanderer stares at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wanderer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Homonculus appears in a man-like form, about 18'' tall, it has a
greenish, reptilian skin, leathery wings, and a bat-like mouth, with
teeth gleaming yellow.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The homonculus is here, looking at you with an evil look.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle homonculus homo

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The head and torso of a chreffn is copper-covered, with yellow,
glowing eyes. The lower body is in an orange shading.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The chreffn are crawling here, looking around with their yellow eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chreffn

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It's a five feet tall, shadow monster. The shape of this creature lies
somewhere between a human and a rat. It breaths very heavily, while staring
at you with such a glint in the eyes that reminds you of immense hunger.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The morkoth is standing here, waiting for someone to KILL!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle morkoth

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie. It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A horrifying mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mud monster mudmonster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The red dragon stares at you, angrily, as it wakes when you
arrives.  It says 'Oh, human YOU woke me up ... Hsss', while
it moves closer.  'Can one NEVER sleep in peace ... Hsss'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The red fierce-looking dragon stares at you angrily.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle red dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The sea hag is so ghastly looking that you feel the deepest fear.
Big yellow eyes and sharp teeth.  Its ears are very big,
and it has small sharp horns.  It hates beauty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The sea hag is swimming around here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sea hag

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The naga are a snake-liked creature. She is covered in green-gold
scale with silvery triangles along her back. Her eyes are golden.
She notice that you look at her, and she says: 'Watch out. This way
leads to some evil creatures'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The guardian naga looks kindly at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guardian naga

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The basilisk is a reptilian monster. It has eight legs, and a strong
toothy jaws. It is dull brown with yellowish underbelly. It's eyes are
glowing pale green.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The scaled basilisk crawls towards you slowly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle basilisk

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This looks like a vaguely human blob. Big black yellow eyes, and a
mouth going a little bit out from the face. The lemure does not look
interested in you at all, but anyway it attacks. It looks like it's
mind has been burned out.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The lemure blob slithers terribly precisely towards you for an attack!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lemure blob

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
At the first sight you thought Jones was an orc, but when it came
closer you saw his second head. He wears an animal skin dress,
filthy and moth eaten. Jones really stinks...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Jones 'Cruncher' the ettin is standing here glaring at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jones cruncher ettin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
When you look at Herald, you feel pity. His dress are really poor,
and the one of his heads hangs down. At the rope around his stomach
hangs dead mouses and rats. He does not smell good.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Herald 'Mouse-Killer' the ettin is standing here looking confused at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle herald mouse killer ettin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It's a seven foot tall humanoid dressed in a purple cloak, and swinging a
black and purple rod above its head as if it was going to attack you any
moment now. In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The master mindflayer is here, looking at you with an evil look.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle master mind mindflayer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high. Dressed in purple and black,
and carrying a large mace in its hand. In the center of its head are four large
tentacles with very sharp points.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The senior mindflayer walks around here, looking for something useful.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle senior mind mindflayer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This mindflayer is six foot high. It has a small mace in its belt, and is
dressed in purple and black cloth. It has four small tentacles in the
center of its head.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The junior mindflayer is here, watching you carefully from the corner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle junior mind mindflayer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The wererat is about four foot tall. It looks very much like rat, except
that it is standing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An ugly wererat is here, looking at you with a strange flick in his eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wererat rat were

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The gigantic rat is about ten foot long from head to tail and has claws
the size of your head looking very nasty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: There is a gigantic rat here, looking at you with a hungry look.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rat gigantic
